title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled“Is technology making people lazy?”.The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words . Many studies claim that computers distract people, make them lazy thinkers and even lower their work efficiency.
reference: Is technology making people lazy? My answer is a qualified yes: while technology itself is neutral, the way most of us use it does breed laziness of both mind and body. To begin with, technology encourages mental laziness. When a search engine can answer any question in seconds and a navigation app can guide every turn, few people bother to think, memorize or reason on their own. Gradually, we outsource our brains and lose the habit of deep thinking. Physical laziness follows the same logic: with delivery apps and online services, many people rarely walk, cook or move, so their bodies grow as idle as their minds. Admittedly, technology can also make us more efficient. Yet the tool is not to blame; our passive dependence is. Therefore, the real question is not whether technology makes us lazy, but whether we control it or let it control us. Used wisely, it frees us; used blindly, it enslaves us.
keyPoints: 首段亮辩证立场。以题目设问 “Is technology making people lazy?” 开头，“My answer is a qualified yes” 直接表态，“while technology itself is neutral” 用 while 让步定调，落实了首段“设问 —表态—定调”的功能，并用 “both mind and body” 一句点出两条线。
两例论证＋回扣懒。“To begin with, technology encourages mental laziness” 亮出分论 点，用 search engine、navigation app 当例子；“Physical laziness follows the same logic” 递进接上 第二例，两条线都落回 laziness，实现主体段“主题句—例子—让步—回扣”。
归因于人并升华。“Yet the tool is not to blame; our passive dependence is” 把责任从科 技转到人，“Used wisely, it frees us; used blindly, it enslaves us” 用对照句升华，收束辩证立场，呼应 开头。
